resetDescription:
This will:

- Remove saved connections and local authorization credentials
- Restore language, appearance, hints, and default cloud locations
- Clear the current rule chain

It will not delete real files or undo completed renames.
readFailed: Could not load app settings. Using default settings for now. Check the connection and refresh the page to try again.

resetUnknown: Some rename results are unconfirmed. Refresh the directory, or check the files at their source before running this operation again.
resetBusy: A preview is being generated or names are being changed. Wait for it to finish before resetting.
resetSaving: Other operations are in progress. Try again shortly.
